introduce: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your hands behind your ears. \n\nRaise and twist your torso so your right elbow moves to meet your left knee. Repeat with the other side.
name: CROSSOVER CRUNCH

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Raise your upper body to bring your elbows towards your knees.
Exhale as you slowly raise your upper body, and inhale as you return to the start position.
Your neck shouldn't feel sore.
This exercise targets the obliques and rectus abdominis.
This exercise can tone your abs and treat lower back pain.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the left, keeping shoulders grounded. 

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back, arms extended to the sides, palms facing down.

Inhale to bend your knees and draw them toward your chest. Exhale, lower both knees to the right, keeping shoulders grounded.

Hold this position. Breathe steadily, deepening the twist with each exhale.
name: LYING TWIST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: You need to do this exercise on a mat.
Please make sure your knees are together.
Please always keep your shoulders on the floor.
Inhale to lengthen your body. Exhale to deepen the twist.
You should feel a gentle stretch on your opposite waist.
You shouldn’t feel any pain.
This exercise stretches your obliques and lower back.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your left knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your left knee towards your chest, keeping your right leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH LEFT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with legs extended. 

Inhale, lift your right knee and grab it with both hands.  Exhale slowly, pull your right knee towards your chest, keeping your left leg straight.

Hold this position for a few seconds, breathing smoothly and steadily.
name: KNEE TO CHEST STRETCH RIGHT

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Keep your back flat on the floor.
Inhale to expand your chest. Exhale to draw the knee closer to your chest.

introduce:
Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor. 

Put your arms straight over your head. 

Slide your forearms down at 90 degree angles, then slide them up. Repeat the exercise.
name: FLOOR SLIDES

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Please try to keep your elbows and wrists always on the floor.
Slide your arms up as high as possible without letting your lower back off the floor.
Take a deep breath in as you slide your arms up towards your head.
Exhale slowly as you slide your arms back down towards your sides.

introduce: Lie on your back with your toes towards the ceiling, legs flat on the floor and arms straight overhead. \n\nSwing your legs to your right and hold this position.
name: LYING SWING LEGS LEFT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the left side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

introduce: Lie on your back with your toes towards the ceiling, legs flat on the floor and arms straight overhead. \n\nSwing your legs to your left and hold this position.
name: LYING SWING LEGS RIGHT

tips.text: You should feel a gentle stretch on the right side of your body.
Breathe regularly.

introduce:
Lie down on your back with your legs extended. Relax your spine and gently press your lower back into the floor. 

Inhale, lift your knees toward your chest. Exhale, hug your knees gently.

Hold the position without holding your breath. Inhale as you lengthen your spine. Exhale as you soften your shoulders and hips.
name: DOUBLE KNEES TO CHEST

tips.text: Please do this on a mat.
Hold on your thighs instead if you have knee injuries.
It’s a good exercise to stretch your lower back muscles.
It helps to restore flexibility to your lower back.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to relax your shoulders and hips.

introduce:
Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the floor. Bend your arms forward and rest your hands gently behind your head.

Inhale, gently arch your lower back, allowing a subtle lift while keeping your tailbone grounded. Exhale as you press your lower back into the mat, closing the gap.

Repeat with smooth and steady breaths.
name: THE NO-GAP

tips.text: Please do it on a mat.
Squeeze your glutes and flatten your lower back on the ground.
This exercise can help fix the anterior pelvic tilt.
Inhale to return and relax your back. Exhale to press your lower back down.

introduce: Lie flat on your back with legs extended wider than hip-width apart, arms relaxed by your sides, palms up. \n\nInhale slowly through your nose, your spine gently lengthening and your body becoming light. Exhale fully, allowing your shoulders, hips, and entire body to melt into the mat, and consciously relax any areas of tightness or tension throughout your body.
name: RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Close your eyes, relax your arms and legs, relax your face, relax the ankles.
Inhale to lengthen your spine. Exhale to release tension of your body.
Let any weight, any tension relax to the earth, feel the floor below you, supporting you.
Let every part of your body relax and lower to the ground.
Invite rest and peace into your mind, body and soul.

introduce:
Lie down on the floor in complete relaxation with your legs straight.

Inhale as you extend your arms overhead, letting them fall naturally and opening through your shoulders. Exhale, allow your body to settle and relax deeper into the floor.

Hold the position, feeling your body stretch fully with each inhale and exhale.
name: EXTENDED RELAXATION LYING POSE

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Feel the support of the earth on your back.
Inhale deeply to lengthen your spine. Exhale fully to relax and deepen the stretch.

introduce:
Lie on your back. Bring your knees towards your chest and hold them with your hands. 

Draw circles clockwise with your knees several times, feeling a gentle massage on your lower back, then switch direction and repeat.

Make sure your lower back is firmly against the mat and don't tilt sideways while rotating your knees. Breathe naturally during the exercise.
name: RECLINED KNEE CIRCLES

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Make sure your lower back is firm on the mat throughout the exercise.
Breathe naturally.
This exercise helps release tightness in your knee joints.
This exercise helps release stress in your lower back.

introduce: Lie on your back with your legs bent, and feet flat on the mat, shoulder-width apart. Inhale and raise your arms overhead.\n\nAlternate tilting your legs to the left and right. Repeat the exercise.
name: SUPINE WINDSHIELD WIPERS

tips.text: Please prepare a mat.
Breathe regularly.
This exercise can relax your lower back and hips.
